title: Sealed plaintext
description: What the envelope of secrets-answer.schema.json opens to: the digest, the requested credentials and a value for each, nothing else. Whoever opens it checks run_configuration against the digest it computed and credentials against the set it requested. values has exactly one value for each name of credentials, sorted by credential. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object.

version.description: The document format. A version other than 1 is refused.

run_configuration.description: The digest of the run configuration the values were sealed for, sha256= and 64 lower-case hex digits.

credentials.description: The credentials of the request, sorted.

values.description: The values, one per credential, sorted by credential.

credential.description: The credential's name, one of credentials.

value.description: The value: UTF-8 text of 1 to 16384 bytes with no NUL; the schema's maxLength counts characters and bounds it from above. A value set in a header must also have no control character other than tab and no leading or trailing space or tab.
